summaries.Good news: Brazil's Wolbachia mosquito program has cut viral infections by 68%, while distributed acts of kindness—from repurposed instruments feeding birds to nationwide Thanksgiving meal programs—show how individual promises scale into community care.
summaries.Ideas: AI is reshaping enterprise workflows and workplace dynamics, while corporate leadership faces unprecedented scrutiny over governance, authenticity, and the gap between innovation promises and human impact.
